body:
## Summary

This adds `research/session-receipt-20261022/`, a **navigation receipt** for the 37 open PRs I opened in one donated session, #4513–#4591, as of 08:45 UTC. It is for intake. For each PR it records the head, package(s), subject, type and a one-line description. It also records the edges that matter when merging. **No new κ. No closures recommended.**

## Merge-relevant edges

- **#4535 rank chain (same κ).** #4563 (13×) → #4564 (`d = 10^−12`, 34×) → #4565 (retuned majorant, 85×). #4565's verifier reproduces the other two as controls, so if only one is wanted, #4565 carries all three numbers.
- **#4568 (hexapode)** builds on #4564. #4570 checks #4568 and gives a 6.9× smaller rank via #4565.
- **#4554 (Dugongue)** has an independent check of every constructive component: #4556–#4562 and #4566.
- **#4567 and mihir-s-05's #4581** agree exactly in all 128 windows. #4567 also covers nonadjacent pairs, `|c| ≤ 3` and retiming.
- **#4532.** #4537 (finite figures) and #4569 (written proof) are complementary. #4591 covers the #4483 Chernoff layer that #4532 inherits.

Types: 27 checks, 4 extensions, 3 same-κ rank reductions, 1 negative result, 1 receipt and 1 repair, across 57 packages in 12 subject groups.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/session-receipt-20261022
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/session-receipt-20261022 outcome=completed
```

The verifier checks internal consistency only (SHAs, distinct PRs and packages, edges, coverage set), so it replays after merges.
